## Task

Create a new markdown document containing 5 post drafts optimized for virality on LinkedIn.

## Guidelines

1. 1-liner hook (must-have)
   First line is make-or-break.
   Emotional hooks matter more than perfect grammar (you may call it clickbait but it works).
2. Examples or "quotations"
3. Easy P.S. question in the end
4. Create visual hooks (quotes or photos)
5. Keep all posts under 90s reading time

Story-based posts get 2x more engagement

Short paragraphs and bullet points increase readability and shares.

## User Actions (Follow up)

- No Hashtags
- Add 5-7 "pinned" comments for each post
- Spend minimum 1h in the comments (must)
- Repost every post at least once (6-8h later)
